receiver_protocol.semantic_update: fixed bit-marginal semantic LLRs from the ByT5 byte posterior within each assisted BP run
receiver_protocol.stopping: syndrome check; up to six semantic invocations; up to 50 BP iterations per run

experiment.snr_definition: linear SNR = symbol power / real AWGN variance = 2 Es/N0

metric_definitions.num_samples: Number of transmitted blocks at this SNR in the selected source run.
metric_definitions.sentence_errors: Final information-block errors, including syndrome-valid incorrect outputs.
metric_definitions.final_undetected_errors: Final syndrome-valid incorrect blocks; their rate uses num_samples as denominator.
metric_definitions.pure_prefix: Conventional BP evaluated on the same transmissions as the semantic receiver at this SNR.
metric_definitions.confidence_sequence: Stored 95% beta-binomial mixture confidence sequence, Beta(1/2,1/2); one receiver and one SNR, not simultaneous coverage over all curves.
metric_definitions.stopping: Original target, maximum sample count, batch size and actual stop reason are retained per SNR.
metric_definitions.semantic_budget_and_round_metrics: Retained from the chosen source summary under its recorded semantic_budget_scope; not new standalone Monte-Carlo runs.
metric_definitions.timing: Original run telemetry only; mixed hardware and batched execution. Not the dedicated latency benchmark.
metric_definitions.sentence_bert: Check sentence_bert_num_samples; unavailable or unevaluated source values are retained without imputation.

merge_policy.note: Each high-SNR point is replaced by its designated rerun, not added to the older sample/error counts. Pure-BP, byte-error, confidence, stopping, and other per-SNR fields are taken together from that same rerun.
merge_policy.source_metadata: Run-specific seeds, software/hardware, execution settings and replay fingerprints are recorded under source_runs; no single global seed or hardware is asserted.
merge_policy.cross_receiver_pairing: Paired BP is valid within each source run. The SF-BP and BM-BP high-SNR reruns use different random seeds and must not be treated as transmission-paired with each other.
merge_policy.integer_encoding: Replay sentence_seed and noise_stream_seed are exact decimal strings to avoid loss of 64-bit precision in JSON consumers; ordinary counts and base seeds remain numbers.
merge_policy.source_locators: Project-relative provenance labels, not a claim that the original source files or code are publicly hosted.

audit.snr_definition: linear SNR = symbol power / real AWGN variance = 2 Es/N0
audit.bler_definition: any incorrect payload information bit, including syndrome-valid wrong outputs
audit.byte_er_definition: position-wise raw-byte mismatches / transmitted payload bytes; before display replacement
audit.confidence_sequence_sampling: IID assumes with-replacement source sampling and independent AWGN
audit.timing_scope: telemetry only; latency benchmarking must be run separately
